questions.text: यदि tan 3θ = √3 है, तो θ/2 बराबर है:
questions.text_english: If tan 3θ = √3, then θ/2 equals:
questions.solution: We know tan 60° = √3. So tan 3θ = tan 60°, which gives 3θ = 60°, hence θ = 20°. Therefore θ/2 = 20°/2 = 10°. Option (D) is correct. Option (A) 60° would mean θ = 120° which gives tan 360° ≠ √3. Option (B) 30° would require θ = 60°, giving tan 180° = 0 ≠ √3. Option (C) 20° would require θ = 40°, giving tan 120° = -√3 ≠ √3.

questions.text: यदि 4, 6, 8 का ल.स. (LCM) x है, 3, 5, 7 का ल.स. y है तथा x और y का ल.स. p है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?
questions.text_english: If x is the LCM of 4, 6, 8 and y is the LCM of 3, 5, 7 and p is the LCM of x and y, then which of the following is true?
questions.solution: LCM of 4, 6, 8: 4 = 2², 6 = 2×3, 8 = 2³, so x = 2³×3 = 24. LCM of 3, 5, 7: y = 3×5×7 = 105. LCM of x and y: p = LCM(24, 105). Since 24 = 2³×3 and 105 = 3×5×7, p = 2³×3×5×7 = 840. Now checking option (B): 4y = 4×105 = 420. That is incorrect. Let us recheck: p = 840, x = 24, y = 105. p/y = 840/105 = 8, so p = 8y. But that is not an option exactly. p/x = 840/24 = 35, so p = 35x. Therefore the correct answer is (A) p = 35x.

questions.text: 'k' का वह मान जिसके लिए रैखिक समीकरण निकाय 6x + y = 3k तथा 36x + 6y = 3 के अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं, है:
questions.text_english: The value of 'k' for which the system of linear equations 6x + y = 3k and 36x + 6y = 3 have infinitely many solutions is:
questions.solution: For infinitely many solutions, we need a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂. Here, equation 1: 6x + y = 3k → 6x + y − 3k = 0, and equation 2: 36x + 6y = 3 → 36x + 6y − 3 = 0. So a₁/a₂ = 6/36 = 1/6, b₁/b₂ = 1/6. For the constant ratio: c₁/c₂ = 3k/3 = k. Setting k = 1/6 gives all three ratios equal to 1/6, satisfying the condition for infinitely many solutions. Therefore k = 1/6, and option (B) is correct.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
questions.topic: Conditions for Consistency of Linear Equations

questions.text: यदि α तथा β, बहुपद p(x) = x² – ax – b के शून्यक हैं, तो (α + β + αβ) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: If α and β are the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = x² – ax – b, then the value of (α + β + αβ) is equal to:
questions.solution: For the polynomial p(x) = x² – ax – b, by Vieta's formulas: sum of zeroes α + β = a (coefficient of x with negative sign divided by leading coefficient = –(–a)/1 = a), and product of zeroes αβ = –b (constant term divided by leading coefficient = –b/1 = –b). Therefore α + β + αβ = a + (–b) = a – b. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text_english: If x/12 – 3/x = 0, then the values of x are:
questions.solution: Starting with x/12 – 3/x = 0, multiply both sides by 12x (x ≠ 0): x² – 36 = 0, so x² = 36, giving x = ±6. Option (A) is correct. Checking: (6/12) – (3/6) = 0.5 – 0.5 = 0 ✓ and (–6/12) – (3/–6) = –0.5 + 0.5 = 0 ✓.

questions.text: x/4 + y/6 = 1 द्वारा निरूपित रेखा, x-अक्ष तथा y-अक्ष को क्रमशः P तथा Q पर काटती है। रेखाखंड PQ के मध्य-बिंदु के निर्देशांक हैं:
questions.text_english: The line represented by x/4 + y/6 = 1, intersects x-axis and y-axis respectively at P and Q. The coordinates of the mid-point of line segment PQ are:
questions.solution: The line x/4 + y/6 = 1 is in intercept form, where x-intercept = 4 and y-intercept = 6. So P = (4, 0) and Q = (0, 6). Midpoint of PQ = ((4+0)/2, (0+6)/2) = (2, 3). Option (A) is correct. The other options result from incorrect intercept identification or midpoint calculation.

questions.text: △PQR के दो शीर्ष P(–1, 5) तथा Q(5, 2) हैं। रेखाखंड PQ को 2 : 1 के अनुपात में बाँटने वाले बिंदु के निर्देशांक हैं:
questions.text_english: Two of the vertices of △PQR are P(–1, 5) and Q(5, 2). The coordinates of a point which divides PQ in the ratio 2 : 1 are:
questions.solution: Using the section formula, a point dividing P(–1, 5) and Q(5, 2) in ratio 2:1 has coordinates: x = (2×5 + 1×(–1))/(2+1) = (10–1)/3 = 9/3 = 3, and y = (2×2 + 1×5)/(2+1) = (4+5)/3 = 9/3 = 3. So the point is (3, 3). Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में केंद्र O वाले वृत्त पर एक बाह्य बिंदु P से यदि PA तथा PB स्पर्श-रेखाएँ खींची गई हैं जिनके बीच का कोण 80° है, तो ∠POA की माप है:
questions.text_english: If tangents PA and PB drawn from an external point P to the circle with centre O are inclined to each other at an angle of 80° as shown in the given figure, then the measure of ∠POA is:
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. An external point P from which two tangents PA and PB are drawn to the circle. The angle APB = 80° is marked at P. The angle POA is to be determined.
questions.solution: Since OA ⊥ PA (radius to tangent), ∠OAP = 90°. In quadrilateral OAPB: ∠APB + ∠OAP + ∠AOB + ∠OBP = 360°. So 80° + 90° + ∠AOB + 90° = 360°, giving ∠AOB = 100°. Since OP bisects ∠AOB (by symmetry of tangents), ∠AOP = 50°. Therefore ∠POA = 50°. Option (B) is correct.

questions.text: (cot θ + tan θ) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: (cot θ + tan θ) equals:
questions.solution: cot θ + tan θ = cos θ/sin θ + sin θ/cos θ = (cos²θ + sin²θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = 1/(sin θ cos θ) = (1/sin θ)(1/cos θ) = cosec θ · sec θ. Option (A) is correct. The identity sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 is used in the numerator.

questions.text: यदि दो त्रिभुजों △DEF तथा △PQR में, ∠D = ∠Q तथा ∠R = ∠E है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही नहीं है?
questions.text_english: If in two triangles △DEF and △PQR, ∠D = ∠Q and ∠R = ∠E, then which of the following is not true?
questions.solution: Since ∠D = ∠Q and ∠R = ∠E, the third angles must also be equal: ∠F = ∠P. So △DEF ~ △QPR by AA similarity. The corresponding vertices are D↔Q, E↔P, F↔R. Therefore the correct ratios are DE/QP = EF/PR = DF/QR. Checking option (D): DE/PQ = EF/RP — here DE corresponds to QP (not PQ in this arrangement), so this ratio is correct. Actually option (A) states DE/QR = DF/PQ — DE corresponds to QP and DF corresponds to QR, so DE/QP = DF/QR ≠ DE/QR = DF/PQ. Hence option (A) is NOT true. The correct answer is (A).

questions.text: नीचे दी गई आकृति में दो त्रिभुजों LMN तथा ABC के माप दिए गए हैं। भुजा AC की लंबाई है:
questions.text_english: The measurements of △LMN and △ABC are shown in the figure given below. The length of side AC is:
questions.image_description: Two triangles: △LMN with sides LM = 45 cm, LN = 72 cm, MN = 63 cm, angle at M = 130°, angle at N = 28°; and △ABC with AB = 5 cm, angle at A = 22°, angle at B = 130°. AC is to be found.
questions.solution: From the figure, △LMN ~ △ABC (by AA similarity, since ∠M = ∠B = 130°, and the remaining angles match). Corresponding sides: LM ↔ AB, LN ↔ AC, MN ↔ BC. The ratio is AB/LM = 5/45 = 1/9. Therefore AC = LN/9 = 72/9 = 8 cm. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: यदि दो घनों के आयतनों में 8 : 125 का अनुपात है, तो उनके पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफलों में अनुपात है:
questions.text_english: If the volumes of two cubes are in the ratio 8 : 125, then the ratio of their surface areas is:
questions.solution: If the volumes are in ratio 8 : 125, then the ratio of their sides is the cube root: ∛8 : ∛125 = 2 : 5. Surface area of a cube = 6a², so the ratio of surface areas = (2)² : (5)² = 4 : 25. Option (B) is correct.
questions.topic: Surface Area and Volume of Cube

questions.text: यदि 36 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के एक त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल 54π cm² है, तो इस त्रिज्यखंड के संगत चाप की लंबाई है:
questions.text_english: If the area of a sector of circle of radius 36 cm is 54π cm², then the length of the corresponding arc of the sector is:
questions.solution: Area of sector = (1/2) × r × l, where l is the arc length. So 54π = (1/2) × 36 × l, giving l = 54π × 2 / 36 = 108π/36 = 3π cm. Option (D) is correct. Alternatively, using θ/360 × πr² = 54π, we get θ = 15°, and arc length = θ/360 × 2πr = 15/360 × 2π × 36 = 3π cm.
questions.topic: Area and Arc Length of Sector

questions.text: एक पासे को एक बार फेंका जाता है। ऐसी संख्या के आने की प्रायिकता जो 36 का गुणनखंड न हो, है:
questions.text_english: A die is thrown once. The probability of getting a number which is not a factor of 36, is:
questions.solution: Factors of 36 among 1 to 6: 1 (36÷1=36 ✓), 2 (36÷2=18 ✓), 3 (36÷3=12 ✓), 4 (36÷4=9 ✓), 5 (36÷5=7.2 ✗), 6 (36÷6=6 ✓). So factors are {1, 2, 3, 4, 6} — five numbers. Only 5 is not a factor of 36. Probability = 1/6. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text_english: If the mean of 2, 9, x+6, 2x+3, 5, 10, 5 is 7, then the value of x is:
questions.solution: Mean = (sum of all values) / (number of values). Sum = 2 + 9 + (x+6) + (2x+3) + 5 + 10 + 5 = 40 + 3x. Number of values = 7. Mean = (40 + 3x)/7 = 7, so 40 + 3x = 49, giving 3x = 9, thus x = 3. Option (D) is correct.

questions.text: आयत AOBC के तीन शीर्ष A(0, 2), O(0, 0) तथा B(4, 0) हैं। इसके विकर्ण की लंबाई का वर्ग बराबर है:
questions.text_english: AOBC is a rectangle whose three vertices are A(0, 2), O(0, 0) and B(4, 0). The square of the length of its diagonal is equal to:
questions.solution: The rectangle AOBC has vertices A(0, 2), O(0, 0), B(4, 0), and C(4, 2). The diagonal AB connects A(0, 2) and B(4, 0). Length² = (4–0)² + (0–2)² = 16 + 4 = 20. Option (B) is correct. Alternatively, diagonal OC connects O(0,0) and C(4,2): (4–0)² + (2–0)² = 16 + 4 = 20.

questions.text: बहुपद p(x) = x² – 3√2 x + 4 के शून्यक हैं:
questions.text_english: Zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = x² – 3√2 x + 4 are:
questions.solution: For p(x) = x² – 3√2 x + 4, we need two numbers whose sum = 3√2 and product = 4. Testing option (B): 2√2 + √2 = 3√2 ✓ and 2√2 × √2 = 2×2 = 4 ✓. Therefore the zeroes are 2√2 and √2. Option (B) is correct. Option (A): 2 + √2 ≠ 3√2. Option (C): product = 4√2 × (–√2) = –8 ≠ 4.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ABC में, AD ⊥ BC तथा ∠BAC = 90° है। यदि BC = 16 cm तथा DC = 4 cm है, तो x का मान है:
questions.text_english: In the given figure, in △ABC, AD ⊥ BC and ∠BAC = 90°. If BC = 16 cm and DC = 4 cm, then the value of x is:
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with AD perpendicular to BC. Angle BAC = 90°. BC = 16 cm, DC = 4 cm. The side AC is labelled x.
questions.solution: In △ABC with ∠BAC = 90° and AD ⊥ BC, by the geometric mean relation: AC² = DC × BC. So x² = 4 × 16 = 64, giving x = 8 cm. Wait — actually AC² = DC × BC gives x² = 4 × 16 = 64, x = 8. But looking at the figure again, x = AC and DC = 4, BC = 16. Using AC² = DC × BC: x² = 4 × 16 = 64, x = 8. However, checking option (A) = 4: if x = AD (altitude), then AD² = BD × DC = 12 × 4 = 48, AD = 4√3 ≠ 4. The correct answer using AC² = DC × BC is x = 8 cm, so option (C) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): दीवार के साथ लगी हुई एक सीढ़ी के पाद की दीवार से क्षैतिज दूरी 6 m है। यदि यह दीवार पर 8 m ऊँचाई तक पहुँचती है, तो सीढ़ी की लंबाई 10 m है।
तर्क (R): सीढ़ी, भूमि से 60° का कोण बनाती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): A ladder leaning against a wall, stands at a horizontal distance of 6 m from the wall. If the height of the wall up to which the ladder reaches is 8 m, then the length of the ladder is 10 m.
Reason (R): The ladder makes an angle of 60° with the ground.
questions.instruction_line: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): Ladder length = √(6² + 8²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10 m. This is TRUE. Reason (R): Angle with ground = arctan(8/6) = arctan(4/3) ≈ 53.13°, not 60°. So Reason (R) is FALSE. Therefore, Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): एक बाह्य बिंदु से वृत्त पर खींची गई दो स्पर्श-रेखाएँ, वृत्त के केंद्र पर समान कोण अन्तरित करती हैं।
तर्क (R): एक वृत्त के परिगत समांतर चतुर्भुज, एक समचतुर्भुज होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If two tangents are drawn to a circle from an external point, then they subtend equal angles at the centre of the circle.
Reason (R): A parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.
questions.instruction_line: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): Two tangents from an external point are equal in length, and by symmetry (OA = OB as radii and OP is common), the two triangles OAP and OBP are congruent, so ∠AOP = ∠BOP. Hence the tangents subtend equal angles at the centre. Assertion (A) is TRUE. Reason (R): A parallelogram circumscribing a circle has all tangent lengths equal, which implies all four sides are equal, making it a rhombus. Reason (R) is also TRUE. However, Reason (R) does not explain Assertion (A) — they are independent properties of tangents. Option (B) is correct.

questions.text: यदि 4k = tan² 60° – 2 cosec² 30° – 2 tan² 30° है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If 4k = tan² 60° – 2 cosec² 30° – 2 tan² 30°, then find the value of k.

key_points: Substitute standard values: tan 60° = √3, cosec 30° = 2, tan 30° = 1/√3

questions.solution: We know tan 60° = √3, so tan² 60° = 3. Also cosec 30° = 2, so cosec² 30° = 4. And tan 30° = 1/√3, so tan² 30° = 1/3. Substituting: 4k = 3 – 2(4) – 2(1/3) = 3 – 8 – 2/3 = –5 – 2/3 = –17/3. Therefore k = –17/12.

questions.text: एक निश्चित परीक्षा प्रश्न के सही उत्तर का अनुमान लगाने की प्रायिकता x/12 है। यदि इसी प्रश्न के सही उत्तर का अनुमान न लगा पाने की प्रायिकता 5/6 है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The probability of guessing the correct answer of a certain test question is x/12. If the probability of not guessing the correct answer is 5/6, then find the value of x.
questions.solution: Since the sum of probability of an event and its complement equals 1: P(correct) + P(not correct) = 1. So x/12 + 5/6 = 1, which gives x/12 = 1 – 5/6 = 1/6, and therefore x = 12/6 = 2.

sub_questions.text: वह छोटी से छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 644 तथा 462 दोनों से विभाजित हो।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the smallest number which is divisible by both 644 and 462.
sub_questions.solution: To find the smallest number divisible by both 644 and 462, we find their LCM. Prime factorisation: 644 = 2² × 7 × 23 and 462 = 2 × 3 × 7 × 11. LCM = 2² × 3 × 7 × 11 × 23 = 4 × 3 × 7 × 11 × 23 = 21252. The required smallest number is 21252.

sub_questions.text: दो संख्याएँ 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा उनका म.स. (HCF) 11 है। इन संख्याओं का ल.स. (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 and their HCF is 11. Find the LCM of these numbers.
sub_questions.solution: Since the two numbers are in ratio 4:5 and their HCF is 11, the numbers are 44 and 55. Using the relationship LCM × HCF = product of the two numbers: LCM × 11 = 44 × 55 = 2420. Therefore LCM = 2420/11 = 220.

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice sub-parts (a) and (b). Attempt any one.

sub_questions.text: यदि द्विघात समीकरण 4x² + kx + 1 = 0 के मूल वास्तविक और समान हैं, तो 'k' का/के मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value(s) of 'k' so that the quadratic equation 4x² + kx + 1 = 0 has real and equal roots.

key_points: For real and equal roots, discriminant D = 0

sub_questions.solution: For real and equal roots, the discriminant must be zero: D = b² – 4ac = 0. Here a = 4, b = k, c = 1. So k² – 4×4×1 = 0, giving k² = 16, thus k = ±4.

sub_questions.text: यदि 'α' तथा 'β', बहुपद p(y) = y² – 5y + 3 के शून्यक हैं, तो α⁴β³ + α³β⁴ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If 'α' and 'β' are the zeroes of the polynomial p(y) = y² – 5y + 3, then find the value of α⁴β³ + α³β⁴.

key_points: α + β = 5 and αβ = 3 (by Vieta's formulas)

sub_questions.solution: By Vieta's formulas for p(y) = y² – 5y + 3: α + β = 5 and αβ = 3. Now, α⁴β³ + α³β⁴ = α³β³(α + β) = (αβ)³ × (α + β) = (3)³ × 5 = 27 × 5 = 135.

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice sub-parts (a) and (b). Attempt any one.
questions.topic: Zeroes and Coefficients of a Polynomial

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि वृत्त के किसी व्यास के सिरों पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाएँ परस्पर समांतर होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Prove that the tangents drawn at the ends of a diameter of a circle are parallel.

key_points: Let AB be a diameter and PQ, RS be tangents at A and B respectively
OA ⊥ PQ and OB ⊥ RS (radius is perpendicular to tangent at point of contact)
Therefore ∠OAP = ∠OBR = 90°, which are alternate interior or co-interior angles, proving PQ || RS

questions.solution: Let AB be a diameter of a circle with centre O, and let PQ and RS be tangents drawn at A and B respectively. Since a tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact, OA ⊥ PQ and OB ⊥ RS. This gives ∠OAP = 90° and ∠OBR = 90°. Since ∠OAP + ∠OBR = 180° (co-interior angles), or since both are 90° meaning each tangent is perpendicular to the same line AB, PQ is parallel to RS. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: यदि बिंदुओं A(3, 4) तथा B(k, 6) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य-बिंदु P(x, y) है तथा x + y – 10 = 0 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the mid-point of the line segment joining the points A(3, 4) and B(k, 6) is P(x, y) and x + y – 10 = 0, find the value of k.
sub_questions.solution: The midpoint P of A(3, 4) and B(k, 6) is P = ((3+k)/2, (4+6)/2) = ((3+k)/2, 5). So x = (3+k)/2 and y = 5. Substituting in x + y – 10 = 0: (3+k)/2 + 5 – 10 = 0, which gives (3+k)/2 = 5, so 3+k = 10, thus k = 7.

sub_questions.text: बिंदुओं A(–2, 2) तथा B(2, 8) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को चार समान भागों में बाँटने वाले बिंदुओं के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of the points which divide the line segment joining A(–2, 2) and B(2, 8) into four equal parts.

key_points: Three division points divide AB into four equal parts at ratios 1:3, 1:1 (midpoint), 3:1

sub_questions.solution: To divide A(–2, 2) and B(2, 8) into four equal parts, we find three points. First point P₁ divides AB in ratio 1:3: x₁ = (1×2 + 3×(–2))/(1+3) = (2–6)/4 = –1, y₁ = (1×8 + 3×2)/4 = 14/4 = 7/2. Midpoint P₂ = ((–2+2)/2, (2+8)/2) = (0, 5). Third point P₃ divides in ratio 3:1: x₃ = (3×2 + 1×(–2))/4 = 4/4 = 1, y₃ = (3×8 + 1×2)/4 = 26/4 = 13/2. The three points are P₁(–1, 7/2), P₂(0, 5), P₃(1, 13/2).

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice sub-parts (a) and (b). Attempt any one.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि (5√3 + 2/3) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है, जबकि दिया गया है कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that (5√3 + 2/3) is an irrational number given that √3 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume 5√3 + 2/3 is rational, say equal to p/q where p, q are integers and q ≠ 0
This contradicts the given fact that √3 is irrational, so our assumption is wrong

questions.solution: Assume, for contradiction, that 5√3 + 2/3 is rational. Then 5√3 + 2/3 = p/q for some integers p and q with q ≠ 0. This gives 5√3 = p/q – 2/3 = (3p – 2q)/(3q), and so √3 = (3p – 2q)/(15q). Since p, q are integers, (3p – 2q)/(15q) is rational, which means √3 is rational. But this contradicts the given fact that √3 is irrational. Therefore our assumption is wrong, and 5√3 + 2/3 is an irrational number.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: √((sec A – 1)/(sec A + 1)) + √((sec A + 1)/(sec A – 1)) = 2 cosec A
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: √((sec A – 1)/(sec A + 1)) + √((sec A + 1)/(sec A – 1)) = 2 cosec A

key_points: = [(sec A – 1) + (sec A + 1)] / tan A = 2 sec A / tan A
= 2(1/cos A)/(sin A/cos A) = 2/sin A = 2 cosec A = RHS

sub_questions.solution: LHS = √((sec A–1)/(sec A+1)) + √((sec A+1)/(sec A–1)). Combining over a common denominator: = [√(sec A–1)² + √(sec A+1)²] / √(sec²A–1) = [(sec A–1) + (sec A+1)] / √(tan²A) = 2 sec A / tan A. Now, 2 sec A / tan A = 2(1/cos A) / (sin A/cos A) = 2/sin A = 2 cosec A = RHS. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: (1/cos A – cos A)(1/sin A – sin A) = 1/(tan A + cot A)
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: (1/cos A – cos A)(1/sin A – sin A) = 1/(tan A + cot A)

key_points: = (sin²A/cos A)(cos²A/sin A) = sin A cos A
RHS = 1/(tan A + cot A) = 1/((sin²A + cos²A)/(sin A cos A)) = sin A cos A

sub_questions.solution: LHS = (1/cos A – cos A)(1/sin A – sin A) = ((1–cos²A)/cos A)((1–sin²A)/sin A) = (sin²A/cos A)(cos²A/sin A) = sin A cos A. For RHS: tan A + cot A = sin A/cos A + cos A/sin A = (sin²A + cos²A)/(sin A cos A) = 1/(sin A cos A). So 1/(tan A + cot A) = sin A cos A = LHS. Hence proved.

questions.text: 10 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक जीवा, वृत्त के केंद्र पर समकोण अन्तरित करती है। संगत लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। [π = 3·14 प्रयोग कीजिए]
questions.text_english: A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre of the circle. Find the area of the corresponding minor segment. [Use π = 3·14]
questions.solution: Given: radius r = 10 cm and central angle θ = 90°. Area of the sector = (θ/360°) × πr² = (90/360) × 3.14 × 100 = (1/4) × 314 = 78.5 cm². Area of the isosceles right triangle formed by the two radii = (1/2) × r × r × sin 90° = (1/2) × 10 × 10 × 1 = 50 cm². Area of minor segment = Area of sector – Area of triangle = 78.5 – 50 = 28.5 cm².
questions.topic: Area of Segment of a Circle

questions.text: तीन निष्पक्ष सिक्कों को एक साथ उछाला गया। निम्नलिखित के प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए: (क) ठीक दो पट (ख) कम-से-कम एक चित (ग) अधिक-से-अधिक दो चित
questions.text_english: Three unbiased coins are tossed simultaneously. Find the probability of getting: (a) exactly two tails (b) at least one head (c) at most two heads

sub_questions.text: ठीक दो पट
sub_questions.text_english: exactly two tails
sub_questions.solution: Sample space = {HHH, HHT, HTH, THH, HTT, THT, TTH, TTT}. Favourable outcomes for exactly two tails: {HTT, THT, TTH} = 3. P(exactly two tails) = 3/8.

sub_questions.text: कम-से-कम एक चित
sub_questions.text_english: at least one head
sub_questions.solution: Favourable outcomes (at least one head — all except TTT): 7. P(at least one head) = 7/8. Alternatively, P = 1 – P(no head) = 1 – 1/8 = 7/8.

sub_questions.text: अधिक-से-अधिक दो चित
sub_questions.text_english: at most two heads
sub_questions.solution: At most two heads means 0, 1, or 2 heads. Outcomes: TTT (0H), HTT, THT, TTH (1H), HHT, HTH, THH (2H) = 7 outcomes. P(at most two heads) = 7/8. Alternatively, P = 1 – P(3 heads) = 1 – 1/8 = 7/8.

questions.solution: Sample space when three coins are tossed: {HHH, HHT, HTH, THH, HTT, THT, TTH, TTT}, total 8 outcomes. (a) Exactly two tails: {HTT, THT, TTH} — P = 3/8. (b) At least one head: all except TTT — P = 7/8. (c) At most two heads: all except HHH — P = 7/8.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, PC बिंदु C पर वृत्त की स्पर्श-रेखा है तथा AOB व्यास है, जो बढ़ाने पर स्पर्श-रेखा को P पर मिलता है। यदि ∠PCA = 110° है, तो ∠CBA तथा ∠BCO ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PC is a tangent to the circle at C. AOB is the diameter which when extended meets the tangent at P. Find ∠CBA and ∠BCO, if ∠PCA = 110°.
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O and diameter AOB. C is a point on the circle. PC is the tangent at C. AOB extended meets the tangent at P. Angle PCA = 110°.
questions.solution: Since PC is tangent at C and OC is radius, OC ⊥ PC, so ∠OCP = 90°. Therefore ∠OCA = ∠PCA – ∠OCP = 110° – 90° = 20°. Since OA = OC (radii), △OAC is isosceles, so ∠OAC = ∠OCA = 20°. Now ∠CBA = ∠OAC = 20° (angles in the same segment subtended by arc BC). For ∠BCO: ∠ACB = 90° (angle in semicircle), so ∠ACO + ∠BCO = 90°. Since OC = OA (radii) and ∠OCA = 20°, ∠BCO = 90° – ∠ACB + ∠OCA. In △OCB (OC = OB, isosceles), ∠BCO = ∠OBC. Also ∠COB = 180° – 2∠OBC. Since ∠CBA = 20°, ∠BCO = 20°? Let us recalculate: ∠BCO = 90° – 20° = 70°. Therefore ∠CBA = 20° and ∠BCO = 70°.

questions.text: एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज का परिमाप 32 cm है। यदि प्रत्येक समान भुजा की लंबाई, आधार की लंबाई का 5/6 वाँ भाग है, तो त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 32 cm. If each equal side is 5/6 th of the base, find the area of the triangle.

key_points: Let base = b, then each equal side = 5b/6
Equal sides = 5×12/6 = 10 cm, height = √(10² – 6²) = √64 = 8 cm, Area = (1/2)×12×8 = 48 cm²

questions.solution: Let the base of the isosceles triangle be b cm. Then each equal side = (5/6)b cm. Perimeter = b + 2×(5b/6) = b + 5b/3 = (3b + 5b)/3 = 8b/3 = 32. So b = 32×3/8 = 12 cm. Each equal side = (5/6)×12 = 10 cm. To find the height, drop a perpendicular from the apex to the base. It bisects the base, so the half-base = 6 cm. Height h = √(10² – 6²) = √(100 – 36) = √64 = 8 cm. Area = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 12 × 8 = 48 cm².

sub_questions.text: एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी के तीसरे तथा सातवें पदों का योगफल 6 है तथा उनका गुणनफल 8 है। इस समांतर श्रेढ़ी के प्रथम 16 पदों का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The sum of the third term and the seventh term of an AP is 6 and their product is 8. Find the sum of the first sixteen terms of the AP.

key_points: Let a₃ = a+2d and a₇ = a+6d; a₃+a₇ = 2a+8d = 6 → a+4d = 3

sub_questions.solution: Let the third term a₃ = a + 2d and seventh term a₇ = a + 6d. Given: a₃ + a₇ = 6, so 2a + 8d = 6, giving a + 4d = 3. Given: a₃ × a₇ = 8. Let a + 4d = 3, so a₃ = 3 – 2d and a₇ = 3 + 2d. Then (3–2d)(3+2d) = 8, which gives 9 – 4d² = 8, so d² = 1/4, d = ±1/2. If d = 1/2: a = 3 – 4(1/2) = 1. S₁₆ = (16/2)[2×1 + 15×(1/2)] = 8[2 + 7.5] = 8 × 9.5 = 76. If d = –1/2: a = 3 – 4(–1/2) = 5. S₁₆ = 8[2×5 + 15×(–1/2)] = 8[10 – 7.5] = 8 × 2.5 = 20. The sum of first 16 terms is 76 or 20.

sub_questions.text: एक पेंटिंग प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेने के लिए बच्चों की न्यूनतम आयु 8 वर्ष है। यह देखा गया कि भाग लेने वालों में से सबसे छोटे बच्चे की आयु 8 वर्ष थी तथा भाग लेने वालों को आयु के अनुसार क्रम में बिठाने पर सार्व अंतर 4 माह का था। यदि सभी भाग लेने वालों की आयु का योगफल 168 वर्ष है, तो पेंटिंग प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेने वाले सबसे बड़े बच्चे की आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The minimum age of children eligible to participate in a painting competition is 8 years. It is observed that the age of the youngest boy was 8 years and the ages of the participants, when seated in order of age, have a common difference of 4 months. If the sum of the ages of all the participants is 168 years, find the age of the eldest participant in the painting competition.

key_points: AP: a = 8 years, d = 4 months = 1/3 year

questions.solution: This question has two internal choice sub-parts (a) and (b). Attempt any one.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, PA, QB तथा RC भुजा AC पर लंबवत हैं। यदि PA = x इकाई, QB = y इकाई तथा RC = z इकाई है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA, QB and RC are perpendicular to AC. If PA = x units, QB = y units and RC = z units, prove that 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.

key_points: In △PAC and △QBC: ∠A = ∠B (alternate angles if lines are parallel), PA || QB || RC

sub_questions.solution: In the figure, PA ⊥ AC, QB ⊥ AC, and RC ⊥ AC, so PA || QB || RC. Consider △PAC and △QBC — since QB || PA, triangles △ABQ and △CAP are similar (AA). From △PAC with QB || PA: QB/PA = BC/AC, so y/x = BC/AC … (i). Similarly from △RCA with QB || RC: QB/RC = AB/AC, so y/z = AB/AC … (ii). Adding (i) and (ii): y/x + y/z = BC/AC + AB/AC = (BC + AB)/AC = AC/AC = 1. Therefore y(1/x + 1/z) = 1, giving 1/x + 1/z = 1/y. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: एक त्रिभुज ABC की भुजाएँ AB और BC तथा माध्यिका AD एक अन्य त्रिभुज PQR की क्रमशः भुजाओं PQ और QR तथा माध्यिका PM के समानुपाती हैं। दर्शाइए कि △ABC ~ △PQR है।
sub_questions.text_english: Sides AB and BC and median AD of triangle ABC are respectively proportional to sides PQ and QR and median PM of △PQR. Show that △ABC ~ △PQR.

key_points: Since AD and PM are medians, BD = BC/2 and QM = QR/2

sub_questions.solution: Given: AB/PQ = BC/QR = AD/PM, where AD and PM are medians to sides BC and QR respectively. Since AD is the median to BC, D is the midpoint of BC, so BD = BC/2. Similarly, M is the midpoint of QR, so QM = QR/2. Therefore AB/PQ = (BC/2)/(QR/2) = AD/PM, which gives AB/PQ = BD/QM = AD/PM. By SSS similarity, △ABD ~ △PQM. Therefore ∠ABD = ∠PQM, i.e., ∠ABC = ∠PQR. Now in △ABC and △PQR: AB/PQ = BC/QR and ∠ABC = ∠PQR. By SAS similarity criterion, △ABC ~ △PQR. Hence shown.

questions.image_description: Sub-part (a): A diagram showing three parallel perpendiculars PA, QB, RC drawn to line AC with P, Q, R above and A, B, C on a horizontal line. PA = x, QB = y, RC = z. Sub-part (b): Two triangles ABC and PQR with medians AD and PM respectively.
questions.solution: This question has two internal choice sub-parts (a) and (b). Attempt any one.

questions.text: एक बर्तन एक उलटे शंकु के आकार का है। इसकी ऊँचाई 8 cm है तथा ऊपर के शिखर, जो खुला है, की त्रिज्या 5 cm है। यह ऊपर तक पानी से भरा है। जब इसमें सीसे की गोलियाँ, जो प्रत्येक 0·5 cm त्रिज्या के गोले के रूप में हैं, डाली गईं, तो बर्तन के पानी का एक-चौथाई भाग पानी बाहर गिर गया। बर्तन में डाली गई सीसे की गोलियों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A vessel is in the form of an inverted cone. Its height is 8 cm and the radius of its top, which is open, is 5 cm. It is filled with water up to the brim. When lead shots, each of which is a sphere of radius 0·5 cm, are dropped into the vessel, one-fourth of the water flows out. Find the number of lead shots dropped in the vessel.

key_points: Volume of water that flows out = (1/4) × 200π/3 = 50π/3 cm³
Volume of each lead shot = (4/3)π(0.5)³ = π/6 cm³

questions.solution: Volume of the conical vessel = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) × π × 5² × 8 = (1/3) × π × 200 = 200π/3 cm³. One-fourth of the water flows out, so volume of water displaced = (1/4) × (200π/3) = 50π/3 cm³. This displaced volume equals the total volume of lead shots dropped in. Volume of each spherical lead shot = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3) × π × (0.5)³ = (4/3) × π × (1/8) = π/6 cm³. Number of lead shots = (50π/3) ÷ (π/6) = (50π/3) × (6/π) = 300/3 = 100. Therefore, 100 lead shots were dropped into the vessel.

questions.text: एक उद्यान डिजाइनर एक आयताकार लॉन की योजना बना रहा है, जिसके चारों ओर एकसमान रास्ता बनाया जाना है। लॉन और रास्ते का कुल क्षेत्रफल 360 वर्ग मीटर है। रास्ते की चौड़ाई हर तरफ से समान है। लॉन की विमाएँ 12 मीटर × 10 मीटर हैं।
questions.text_english:
A garden designer is planning a rectangular lawn that is to be surrounded by a uniform walkway. The total area of the lawn and the walkway is 360 square metres. The width of the walkway is same on all sides. The dimensions of the lawn itself are 12 metres by 10 metres.

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: रास्ते की चौड़ाई को x मीटर लेकर लॉन तथा रास्ते के कुल क्षेत्रफल को निरूपित करने वाला द्विघात समीकरण बनाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Formulate the quadratic equation representing the total area of the lawn and the walkway, taking width of walkway = x m.
sub_questions.solution: With walkway width x m on all sides, the outer rectangle has dimensions (12 + 2x) m by (10 + 2x) m. Total area = (12 + 2x)(10 + 2x) = 360. Expanding: 120 + 24x + 20x + 4x² = 360, giving 4x² + 44x + 120 = 360, so 4x² + 44x – 240 = 0, or simplified: x² + 11x – 60 = 0.

sub_questions.text: रास्ते की चौड़ाई 'x' ज्ञात करने के लिए द्विघात समीकरण हल कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Solve the quadratic equation to find the width of the walkway 'x'.
sub_questions.solution: Solving x² + 11x – 60 = 0: factoring gives (x + 15)(x – 4) = 0. So x = –15 or x = 4. Since width cannot be negative, x = 4 metres. The width of the walkway is 4 m.

sub_questions.text: यदि रास्ते पर टाइलें लगाने का खर्च ₹50 प्रति वर्ग मीटर की दर से ₹12,000 आता है, तो रास्ते का क्षेत्रफल परिकलित कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the cost of paving the walkway at the rate of ₹50 per square metre is ₹12,000, calculate the area of the walkway.

key_points: Area of walkway = Total cost / Rate = 12000 / 50 = 240 m²

sub_questions.solution: Area of walkway = Total cost ÷ Cost per square metre = 12000 ÷ 50 = 240 square metres.

sub_questions.text: लॉन का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the perimeter of the lawn.
sub_questions.solution: The dimensions of the lawn are 12 m × 10 m. Perimeter of the lawn = 2(length + breadth) = 2(12 + 10) = 2 × 22 = 44 metres.

questions.image_description: A rectangular lawn of 12m × 10m surrounded by a uniform walkway of width x m on all sides. The outer rectangle represents the total area (lawn + walkway) = 360 sq m.
questions.solution: Case Study 1 on quadratic equations applied to a garden design problem. Sub-questions cover formulation of quadratic equation, solving it, cost-based calculation, and perimeter.

questions.text: समुद्र के किनारे एक चट्टान पर एक लाइटहाउस खड़ा है, जो पास से गुजरने वाले जहाजों पर नज़र रखता है। एक दिन लाइटहाउस के शिखर से एक जहाज को किनारे की ओर आते देखने पर पाया कि जैसे ही यह बिंदु P से Q की तरफ आता है, तो इसका अवनमन कोण 30° से 45° में बदल जाता है। लाइटहाउस की ऊँचाई 50 मीटर है।
questions.text_english:
A lighthouse stands tall on a cliff by the sea, watching over ships that pass by. One day a ship is seen approaching the shore and from the top of the lighthouse, the angles of depression of the ship are observed to be 30° and 45° as it moves from point P to point Q. The height of the lighthouse is 50 metres.

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: जहाज जब बिंदु Q पर है तो इसकी लाइटहाउस के आधार से दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए, जबकि यहाँ का अवनमन कोण 45° है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance of the ship from the base of the lighthouse when it is at point Q, where the angle of depression is 45°.
sub_questions.solution: When the ship is at Q, angle of depression = 45°. Let QA be the horizontal distance from Q to the base of the lighthouse. tan 45° = height / QA = 50/QA. Since tan 45° = 1, QA = 50 metres.

sub_questions.text: ∠PBA तथा ∠QBA की माप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the measures of ∠PBA and ∠QBA.

key_points: ∠PBA = 30° and ∠QBA = 45° (angles of elevation equal angles of depression)

sub_questions.solution: The angle of depression from the top of the lighthouse to point P is 30°, and to point Q is 45°. By alternate interior angles (horizontal line at top parallel to ground), the angle of elevation from P to the top equals the angle of depression, so ∠PBA = 30° and ∠QBA = 45°.

sub_questions.text: जहाज द्वारा बिंदु P से Q तक तय की गई दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance travelled by the ship between points P and Q.
sub_questions.solution: At point P (angle of depression 30°): tan 30° = 50/PA, so PA = 50/tan 30° = 50/(1/√3) = 50√3 m. At point Q (angle of depression 45°): QA = 50 m. Distance PQ = PA – QA = 50√3 – 50 = 50(√3 – 1) metres.

sub_questions.text: यदि यह जहाज किनारे की ओर चलता रहे तथा Q से A तक आने में 10 मिनट ले, तो इसकी गति Q से A तक km/h में परिकलित कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the ship continues moving towards the shore and takes 10 minutes to travel from Q to A, calculate the speed of the ship in km/h, from Q to A.
sub_questions.solution: Distance QA = 50 m = 50/1000 km = 0.05 km. Time taken = 10 minutes = 10/60 hours = 1/6 hour. Speed = Distance/Time = 0.05 ÷ (1/6) = 0.05 × 6 = 0.3 km/h.

questions.image_description: A lighthouse of height 50 m stands at point B (base) with top at X. A ship moves from P to Q towards the shore at A. Angle of depression from top to P is 30° and to Q is 45°. XB is vertical, PA and QA are horizontal distances.
questions.solution: Case Study 2 on heights and distances. A ship approaches a lighthouse with angles of depression changing from 30° to 45°. Sub-questions involve distance calculation, angle identification, distance travelled, and speed.

questions.text:
भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग प्रत्येक वर्ष देश के विभिन्न उप-विभागों में मौसमी और वार्षिक वर्षा का निरीक्षण करता है। इससे उन्हें परिणामों की तुलना और विश्लेषण करने में सहायता मिलती है।

निम्नलिखित सारणी में उप-विभागों में 2023 में मौसमी वर्षा (mm में) दर्शाई गई है।

वर्षा (mm में) | उप-विभागों की संख्या
200–400 | 3
400–600 | 4
600–800 | 7
800–1000 | 4
1000–1200 | 3
1200–1400 | 3
questions.text_english:
The India Meteorological Department observes seasonal and annual rainfall every year in different sub-divisions of our country. It helps them to compare and analyse the results.

The table below shows sub-divisions wise seasonal (monsoon) rainfall (in mm) in 2023.

Rainfall (mm) | No. of Sub-divisions
200–400 | 3
400–600 | 4
600–800 | 7
800–1000 | 4
1000–1200 | 3
1200–1400 | 3

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: बहुलक वर्ग लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the modal class.
sub_questions.solution: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. From the table, the class 600–800 has the highest frequency of 7 sub-divisions. Therefore, the modal class is 600–800 mm.

sub_questions.text: दिए गए आँकड़ों का माध्यक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the median of the given data.

sub_questions.text: इस मौसम में वर्षा का माध्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the mean rainfall in the season.

sub_questions.text: यदि वर्षा के मौसम के दौरान कम-से-कम 800 mm वर्षा वाले उप-विभाग को अच्छी वर्षा वाला उप-विभाग माना जाता है, तो कितने उप-विभागों में अच्छी वर्षा हुई?
sub_questions.text_english: If a sub-division having at least 800 mm rainfall during monsoon season is considered a good rainfall sub-division, then how many sub-divisions had good rainfall?
sub_questions.solution: Sub-divisions with at least 800 mm rainfall are those in classes 800–1000 (4), 1000–1200 (3), and 1200–1400 (3). Total = 4 + 3 + 3 = 10 sub-divisions had good rainfall.

questions.solution: Case Study 3 on Statistics using rainfall data. Sub-questions cover modal class, median, mean, and counting sub-divisions with good rainfall.
